description: Changes the colour of the damage flash on every entity (including you). One small texture upload when the setting changes; no per-frame cost.

name: Hit Particles
description: Spawns coloured particles when you attack a living entity. Count obeys the performance budget and Safe Mode cap.

name: Critical Particles
description: Adds your own coloured burst when an attack looks like a critical hit (falling, not sprinting, cooldown nearly full). The server decides the real crit; vanilla particles are unchanged.

name: Damage Particles
description: Spawns particles on entities that lose health, scaled by damage taken. Server hurt packets by default; optional synced-health delta mode. Hurt packets do not reveal damage amount.

name: Pearl Trails
description: Coloured particle trail behind ender pearls in flight. Count per tick is capped by the performance budget (Safe Mode: 6).

name: Pearl Trails / Own projectiles only
description: Boolean sub-option of pearl_trails; if blocked, the complete parent module is disabled and hidden.

name: Projectile Trails
description: Coloured particle trail behind arrows, tridents and thrown items in flight (not pearls). Count per tick is capped by the performance budget (Safe Mode: 6).

name: Projectile Trails / Own projectiles only
description: Boolean sub-option of projectile_trails; if blocked, the complete parent module is disabled and hidden.

name: Sword Trails
description: Coloured particles along the sword tip while swinging a sword. Count per tick is capped by the performance budget (Safe Mode: 6).

name: Sharpness Particles
description: Adds a coloured burst on hits made with a Sharpness-enchanted held item (level read from the item you hold). Obeys the performance budget.
